svg.text: stdx's regular expressions against libraries in Rust, Go and Zig, on AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor
The median of 3 jobs, runs 44951158272, 44951166966, 44951169916, at commit 22f6bba.
Each bar is stdx in multiples of the baseline at the line at 1. Every panel shares one logarithmic axis.

A row is level where its whisker touches its panel's band around 1. The band is the most that stdx differed from itself on a row of the
panel: stdx timed first in each round over stdx timed again last, as the median of the jobs. It is never under 5%, since a lead under that
on one CPU model did not hold on another.
A library has no speed on a pattern that it refuses, where its answer is not Go regexp's, and where it has no such call. The report says
